description:
normalize_dns_name at pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:569 and matches_smtp_utf8_mailbox at line 532 call idna::domain_to_ascii. The idna crate's default for that function is UTS#46 'transitional=false' processing (the modern non-transitional form most browsers have settled on).

Real-world consequence: some inputs (e.g., German 'ß' = sharp s) produce different A-labels under transitional vs non-transitional. A target normalized one way and a SAN normalized the other will not match. The choice is intentional but not documented.

Action: add a paragraph to the module-level Limitations section (lib.rs:74-95) naming the IDNA processing mode used and citing the idna crate version. Future contributors who consider switching to idna::Idna::new(...).to_ascii(...) for custom strictness will see the trade-off.
title: idna::domain_to_ascii processing mode (UTS#46 vs IDNA2008-strict) not documented
